items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We had a chance to fraternize with Duke, the boys in the band.

ctx.x: Three weeks getting back. And we came back to Yokinama, and we boarded another boat. This was a different boat. This was a Victory ship, a larger boat. And we were supposed to go into Seattle -- I mean, go into Frisco, and we went into Seattle. And on our way back, we were laying out on deck in the sunshine, listening to the Conn and Joe Louis fight. Coming back.

And we arrived in Seattle, we spent just one day in Seattle. Duke Ellington's band was playing at one of the big places there. We had a chance to fraternize with Duke, the boys in the band. And the next day we left by train. We left for Chicago. We changed trains in Chicago, didn't we, Charles?
Uh-huh. You all did. I went on to New York.
